name: dbg-codex
description: On-demand debugger MCP tools with idle process cleanup and scripted extension deployment.

interface.shortDescription: Start only the debugger MCP tools you need; release idle processes.
interface.longDescription: The plugin automatically gives Codex an on-demand entry point for WinDbg, x64dbg, x32dbg, IDA and Ghidra. Only requested debugger services start, multiple debuggers can be combined, and idle processes are reclaimed after 60 seconds or when the chat turn ends. Ordinary chats start no debugger MCP frontend. A doctor command maintains debugger extensions. WinDbg keeps native-first selection and existing security settings.
defaultPrompt: Run Dbg doctor to detect, update, and repair my debugger extensions and MCP servers.
